what: Text reel — each character cell stacks two copies vertically, and when the text changes (fx:text) every cell rolls 3±1 turns and lands on the new character (1.6s expo.out). Each cell starts .2s + row index × .08s + random order × .04s late, so they settle out of step like a slot machine. With idle set, it rolls once more to the same text every so many seconds while resting (original 6s)

options.each: Random order stagger delay per step (sec), default .04
options.line: Row number — when changing several rows at once, lower rows are delayed by the gap, default 0
options.idle: Interval for rolling again while resting (seconds), 0 turns it off
